+## UBU-D0386: Freeze the complete qualifier fidelity specimen and closed stage dispositions
+
+**Status:** Accepted → DESIGN.md §21.1.1. Narrows `UBU-Q0166`; extends `UBU-D0385` by fixing the input and reporting form for its next investigation without executing a probe, approving a mapping or enabling an adapter.
+
+Adopt specimen `F1` in DESIGN.md §21.1.1 as the complete `perceptual-qualifiers/1` content for the first Discovery-evidence host-mapping probe: evidence `E5@v1` with an observed reading claim and a contradicting inferred claim sharing one frame, each with its own confidence; separately attributed evidence `E6@v1` recording an inconclusive external verification of that reading without a confidence score; and candidate `C5@v1` reusing `UBU-D0334`'s native proposal `N` with field qualifiers citing all three claims. Three single-change negative controls (unknown profile, dangling claim key, stale evidence version) must be rejected before executable review. Fixture labels denote stable schema-valid ids; the harness records its substitution to actual stored ids and versions. Values stay within the safe-integer domain; numeric-domain controls remain `UBU-D0379`'s.
+
+Record one disposition per pinned host stage per specimen from the closed vocabulary `preserved`, `accepted_unread`, `rejected_as_required`, `changed`, `permitted_unavailable` and `unexecuted` defined in §21.1.1. A `changed` row names the first differing path, the exact expected and retrieved values and the first host assignment or decoder identified, and, once the adapter path is pinned, one class: `field_choice`, `missing_adapter_validation`, `implementation_defect` or `host_contract_restriction`. Comparison oracles must not first apply the decoder or serializer under test. Rows from different harnesses do not combine into an end-to-end result.
+
+The mapping satisfies the host-mapping gate only when every required stage for `F1` and the positive scenarios is `preserved`, every negative control is `rejected_as_required`, `permitted_unavailable` appears only in purge, redaction and partial-replication scenarios, and no required stage is `accepted_unread` or `unexecuted`. Only a `changed` row classified `host_contract_restriction`, with a minimal reproduction that no compliant existing payload/ref mapping avoids, routes to `UBU-D0321`'s separate versioned chain review. Restating recorded results in this vocabulary adds no execution: `UBU-D0334`'s normalization loss is `changed`, and its unknown-profile case is also a `missing_adapter_validation` finding. `UBU-Q0166` remains Open; no mapping, repair, passing adapter or governing schema gap is established. No schema, enum, FactProvenance field, pin, migration or producer authority changes here; `UniverseTarget` remains name-only.
+

+        {"term": "inferred", "attribution": {"kind": "model", "ref": "synthetic:vision-model", "revision": "r1"}, "effective_start": "2026-09-19T08:59:30Z", "effective_end": "2026-09-19T08:59:30Z", "recorded_at": "2026-09-19T08:59:31Z", "confidence": {"score": 0.4, "scale": "unit_interval", "method": "synthetic-fixed", "source": {"ref": "synthetic:vision-model", "revision": "r1"}}, "basis": {"kind": "inference", "underlying_kind": "proposed", "model": {"ref": "synthetic:vision-model", "revision": "r1"}, "input_refs": [{"evidence_ref": "E5", "evidence_version": "v1", "selector": "frame:7"}], "assumptions": ["single frame"], "unresolved_alternatives": ["glare absent; digits legible"]}, "related_claims": [{"evidence_ref": "E5", "evidence_version": "v1", "claim_key": "charge_reading", "relation": "contradicts"}, {"evidence_ref": "E5", "evidence_version": "v1", "claim_key": "charge_reading", "relation": "shares_source"}]}

+Candidate `C5@v1` reuses `N` as native proposal and inline payload with candidate `confidence` absent, and carries this companion content in the slot the probe pins; one field has conflicting, differently qualified evidence:
+
+```json
+{"profile":"perceptual-qualifiers/1","field_qualifiers":[{"field_path":["preconditions"],"claim_refs":[{"evidence_ref":"E5","evidence_version":"v1","claim_key":"charge_reading"},{"evidence_ref":"E5","evidence_version":"v1","claim_key":"display_unreliable"},{"evidence_ref":"E6","evidence_version":"v1","claim_key":"meter_check"}]}]}
+```
+
+Derive three negative controls from `F1` by exactly one change each: `F1-unknown` sets `E5`'s `profile` to `perceptual-qualifiers/unknown`; `F1-dangling` changes `C5`'s third `claim_key` to `meter_check_missing`; `F1-stale` changes `C5`'s first `evidence_version` to `v2` while `E5` remains at `v1`. Each must be rejected before executable review or admission with a policy-permitted diagnostic. Native `ok`, durable storage, an API read or an enabled Admit control after any of them records `changed` and a `missing_adapter_validation` finding, not acceptance.
+
+**Stage disposition record.** For each specimen, record exactly one disposition per pinned host stage: canonical schema validation; core Rust/JSON; Discovery evidence storage and reload; candidate storage, reload and replay; the normalization branch the adapter uses; service enqueue and admission; direct review API; authenticated HTTP with disclosure middleware; mounted rendered review; client decoding and emitted request bindings; process/crash recovery; and authorized exchange. A row inherits only its own specimen, harness and pinned revisions; rows from different harnesses do not combine into an end-to-end result, and a disposition is never copied from a superseded revision.
+
+| Disposition | Meaning and required record |
+|---|---|
+| `preserved` | Retrieved structured content equals the expected content for every id, version, field path, attribution, time, qualifier, confidence and link, compared with an oracle that does not first apply the decoder or serializer under test. This establishes structural fidelity at that stage only, not perceptual truth or sufficiency. |
+| `accepted_unread` | The stage accepted the input, but its output was not read back or compared. This is validation evidence only and cannot stand in for `preserved`. |
+| `rejected_as_required` | A negative control was rejected before executable review or admission with a policy-permitted diagnostic, as the contract requires. Record the rejecting stage and exact diagnostic. A rejection of the positive specimen is `changed`, not this disposition. |
+| `changed` | Retrieved content differs from or lacks the expected content. Record the first differing path, exact expected and retrieved values, the first host assignment or decoder identified and, once the adapter path is pinned, one class: `field_choice`, `missing_adapter_validation`, `implementation_defect` or `host_contract_restriction`. |
+| `permitted_unavailable` | The stage returned only a policy-permitted unavailability or incompleteness indicator after purge, redaction or partial replication, exposing no denied content and implying no falsity. Permitted only where the scenario specifies it. |
+| `unexecuted` | The stage did not run for this specimen. It is never inferred from another specimen, harness or revision. |
+
+The pinned mapping satisfies the host-mapping gate only when every required stage for `F1` and each positive scenario above is `preserved`, every negative control is `rejected_as_required`, `permitted_unavailable` appears only in the purge, redaction and partial-replication scenarios, and no required stage is `accepted_unread` or `unexecuted`. Any `changed` row keeps the mapping unresolved. Only a `changed` row classified `host_contract_restriction`, with a minimal reproduction showing that no compliant existing payload/ref mapping avoids it, routes to `UBU-D0321`'s separately reviewed versioned schema/type/store chain change. Restated in this vocabulary without new execution: the carrier specimens' core round trips in `UBU-D0323` and `UBU-D0334` are `preserved` for their content; `UBU-D0334`'s `vet_result` branch is `changed` at `payload.value.perceptual_qualifiers`, expected `P` and retrieved absent, with the assignment recorded there, and its unknown-profile case is also a `missing_adapter_validation` finding because `rejected_as_required` was required; `UBU-D0379`'s integer token is `changed` at the client decoder, with a class that depends on a numeric domain and encoding no decision has selected. `UBU-Q0166` remains Open: no mapping, repair, passing adapter or governing schema gap is established, and no schema, enum, FactProvenance field, pin, migration or producer authority changes here.
+
 **Supported operations.** Validate the native proposal against an already-supported candidate kind and ordinary admission operation before enqueueing an executable review proposal. Unresolved targets, unsupported object kinds and perceptual values without a supported adapter remain Discovery review evidence with the limitation visible; they cannot fall through to a generic mutation executor. `UniverseTarget` advice remains name-only under `UBU-D0296`: it cannot carry, default or admit a perceptual value. The operator may author a value through the ordinary assertion/measurement form linked to the evidence. Future perceptual value-candidate support requires its separately reviewed versioned adapter; this contract does not enable it. Intent, affect, Preferences, completion/effect claims and later-phase Resources/Skills/Techniques retain their existing source and admission gates.
